property_summary: After calling c.deny(alice) where alice is an authorized ward, the reference sets wards[alice] to 0, causing c.allowance(any, any) to revert because mint/auth on share contract uses the Auth modifier and reverts when wards[msg.sender] != 1; the buggy mutant leaves wards[alice] unchanged, so allowance succeeds.
change_summary: Delete the statement that sets wards[user] = 0, so deny never changes the mapping.
